name: Kalthifrons
sum: Pliocene mekosuchine from the Tirari Formation of South Australia, from just before Crocodylus reached the region.
holotype: SAM P35062 — cranium and two mandibular rami, Mampuwordu Sand Member, Tirari Formation.
material: Only the holotype, whose palate is badly weathered.
biology: It lived shortly before Crocodylus appeared in the overlying beds; whether Crocodylus replaced it is unclear.
author: Yates and Pledge 2017
